title: Evidence: Authentication and Pre-Shipping Documentation

attachments.platform_description:
Detailed photos taken January 17 before packaging:
- Full figure: all angles showing paint condition
- Close-up of knee joints: smooth surface with original paint intact, minor texture variation from age
- Blaster: photographed alongside Kenner product reference guide
- COO stamp: clear "Made in Hong Kong" visible on left leg
attachments.title: Pre-Shipping Photos

submitted_text:
Certificate from VintageToysAuth.com (authentication report #VTA-2024-0115-882) dated January 15, 2024. Conclusion: "Authentic 1979 Kenner Boba Fett figure. All components (figure body, blaster, cape) are original Kenner production pieces. COO stamp, paint formulation, and plastic composition consistent with Hong Kong production run."

The listing states "95%+ paint intact" which is an accurate overall figure assessment. What the buyer is photographing as "paint wear" on the knee joints is surface texture variation from the original manufacturing process — vintage Kenner figures have slightly uneven paint application on articulation points due to the dip-coating method used in 1979. This is not paint loss and does not represent an undisclosed condition issue. The figure meets collector-grade "Very Good" standards as listed.{{INJECTION_OM4}}{{INJECTION_OM8}}
